title: Auto-lock after a period of inactivity
line: Vaults can now lock themselves after a chosen number of minutes in which no application has used them.
explanation: A Plasma Vault stayed unlocked until the user locked it by hand, so a forgotten vault could stay open for hours; nothing in plasma-vault watched whether it was still being used. The vault's Advanced settings (and the creation and import wizards) get a "Lock automatically when no application has used it for: N minutes" option. While the vault is open, kded checks every 30 seconds whether any of the user's processes has a file, working directory, mapping or inotify watch (a file manager or editor showing it) inside the vault, and locks it once it has been unused for that long.

commits.message:
kded: add an option to lock a vault when no application uses it

Vaults stayed unlocked until they were locked by hand, which is easy to
forget. A new option locks the vault once no application has had a file,
folder or file manager view open in it for the chosen number of minutes.

BUG: 464945

media.caption: Master: the vault's Advanced settings have no auto-lock option
With the change: new "Lock automatically when no application has used it for" option, set here to 1 minute
Master: Dolphin was closed at 10:54 and the vault is still unlocked at 10:56 (it stays open until locked by hand)
With a 1-minute timeout (4x speed): the vault stayed unlocked for over 2 minutes while Dolphin showed it; after closing Dolphin it locks by itself about a minute later
